card.description: Each row is a scene from a past movie. The virtual production team recorded what each scene needed and whether they filmed it in front of the LED wall or at a real location. This version also includes four combined features built from the original features: Hard to Get To, Can't Control the Sky, Trouble Count, and Busy Night.

context.potentialUses: Predict whether a new scene should be filmed in front of the LED wall or at a real location.

fields.description: A short description of the scene.
Is the location far from where the team works? (Yes or No)
Does it cost a lot to bring the team to this location? (Yes or No)
Would filming this scene for real be dangerous? (Yes or No)
Does the scene need a certain time of day, like sunset or sunrise? (Yes or No)
Does the scene need certain weather, like snow, rain, or fog? (Yes or No)
Does the scene happen at night? (Yes or No)
Does the scene need a big crowd? (Yes or No)
Combined feature: Yes when the location is BOTH far away AND expensive to travel to.
Combined feature: Yes when the scene needs EITHER a specific time of day OR certain weather.
Combined feature: how many of these are Yes: Hard to Get To, Dangerous to Film, Can't Control the Sky (0 to 3).
Combined feature: Yes when the scene is BOTH a night scene AND needs a big crowd.
Where the team filmed the scene: LED Wall or Real Location.
